Hi @ocamlmycaml, sorry for the long delay.

I added a test for `sn_port` being zero in https://github.com/pallets/flask/pull/2928/commits/583da58419e82adc672b5565587d143fbf5b66a6

regarding readability, I kinda agree with you:

```
int(next(p for p in (port, sn_port, _port) if p is not None))
```

is shorter and more intuitive than

```
int(next((p for p in (port, sn_port) if p is not None), _port))
```

I'm having a little problem with your suggestion because it changes the behavior of original code, checking also if `_port` is not None.

How about I rename `_host` and `_port` to `_default_*`? That would make it 

```
int(next((p for p in (port, sn_port) if p is not None), _default_port))
```

which IMO shows the purpose a little better.
